title: test(a2a-server): migrate process.env to vi.stubEnv() per GEMINI.md conventions

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly identifies test files in packages/a2a-server/ where direct process.env modifications are used instead of Vitest's vi.stubEnv() and vi.unstubAllEnvs(), which violates testing conventions in GEMINI.md and can lead to test state leakage.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Migrating direct process.env assignments and deletions to vi.stubEnv() / vi.unstubAllEnvs() across test files in packages/a2a-server is a localized test cleanup with clear requirements and minimal risk.

summary.problem: Test files in packages/a2a-server directly modify process.env instead of using Vitest's vi.stubEnv() and vi.unstubAllEnvs() per GEMINI.md guidelines.
summary.root_cause: Direct assignments and deletions of process.env properties in test setups and test cases cause environment variable state leakage across tests.
summary.context: GEMINI.md specifies using vi.stubEnv('NAME', 'value') in beforeEach and vi.unstubAllEnvs() in afterEach when testing environment variable dependent code.

steps: In packages/a2a-server/src/commands/init.test.ts, replace process.env['CODER_AGENT_WORKSPACE_PATH'] assignment with vi.stubEnv('CODER_AGENT_WORKSPACE_PATH', mockWorkspacePath) and ensure vi.unstubAllEnvs() is invoked in afterEach.
In packages/a2a-server/src/http/app.test.ts, replace direct process.env manipulations (assignments and deletes of CODER_AGENT_WORKSPACE_PATH) with vi.stubEnv and vi.unstubAllEnvs.
Audit packages/a2a-server/src/config/config.test.ts and ensure all environment overrides consistently use vi.stubEnv and vi.unstubAllEnvs.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: All tests in packages/a2a-server run cleanly with environment variable stubs automatically reset after each test.
verification_steps: Verify that tests pass and environment variables are properly unstubbed after each test execution.
